name: Hill Chart
author: marcho78
description: Track your projects at a glance, right on your Omarchy bar. Inspired by Basecamp's Hill Charts, each project is a dot on a hill: it climbs while you figure out the work and rolls down as you get it done. Drag a dot to update it and spot what's stuck.

barWidget.description: Projects on a hill: figuring it out uphill, making it happen downhill

schema.label: Flag a project as stalled after (days, 0 = never)
schema.description: A project that hasn't moved on the hill for this long gets a warning ring.

schema.label: Projects file
schema.description: Where the projects are kept. Empty means ~/.local/share/hillchart/projects.json. Point it into a synced folder to share a hill between machines.
